description: Frozen protocol for the Lattigo v2 calibration and compiled-corpus evaluation.
holdout_rule: Sort the complete BENCHMARKS list in the runner and assign every fourth benchmark (1-based positions divisible by 4) to holdout before measurements. Partial runs retain the same assignments.

measurements.rss_metric: median of per-run /usr/bin/time peak RSS in MiB

acceptance_gates.heldout_budget_false_reject_rate: <= 0.10 among programs whose measured median RSS fits the budget

model_v2.baseline_source: Rounded median RSS from four empty-worker (N,L) microbench pairs.
model_v2.lattigo_parameter_tables: (nQ+nP)*2*N*8 bytes for the resident forward/backward NTT tables.
model_v2.helper_buffers: Source-derived CKKS evaluator, encryptor, decryptor, basis-extender, and encoder buffers; one N-word automorphism index per Galois key; input and output harness scratch.
model_v2.gc_headroom_factor_source: Development-only 95th percentile of (median RSS - estimated baseline - estimated managed live - estimated input plaintext transient)/(estimated managed live) across 74 successful programs measured at GOGC=100; linear interpolation.
model_v2.hi: baseline + managed_live + input_plaintext_transient + managed_live*gc_headroom_factor; development-calibrated estimate, not a physical RSS bound.

tuning_policy: Diagnose and calibrate only on development. The GC/RSS headroom factor is selected from the development residual distribution and evaluated by leave-one-benchmark-out on development. Do not tune against holdout. Freeze and commit v2 before running the holdout, then score the holdout once; the historic aggregate holdout result was seen earlier and must be disclosed.
ast_roots: All variables assigned to encryptedOutputs are combined under a non-allocating Vec root so the estimate covers every output retained by the generated program.
scope: The corpus has 108 planned candidates: all regular benchmarks at widths 4, 8, and 16; dot_product, hamming_dist, and l2_distance additionally at width 32; Conv2D compiler-native at requested widths <= 16; and three Deep Network circuit modes at their listed parameters. CryptoNets is excluded because it is not enabled in the root build; polynomials_coyote emits SEAL code rather than Lattigo. DCT, max, polynomial-derivative, and sort compiler modes may fail generation or parsing and such failures are recorded rather than counted as measurements.

model_v3.formula: v3 = baseline_hat + exact live set (keys, inputs, plaintexts, peak live intermediates, helpers, harness scratch). No gc_headroom_factor, no widened hi: there is only a point estimate.
model_v3.baseline_hat: baseline_hat_mib = a * elf_text_data_mib + b, where elf_text_data_mib comes from GNU size on the COMPILED worker only (the worker is never executed for prediction). (a, b) from RL/v3_baseline_calibration.json, itself an OFFLINE measurement: RSS at the start of main, median of >= 5 runs per binary, accepted iff leave-one-out max error <= 1 MiB. Not measurement-free.
model_v3.object_sizes: Library-driven oracle (BinarySize of empty objects, RL/v3_size_oracle_table.csv, generated by lattigo_backend/v3_size_oracle.go) via fhe_rl.size_oracle.object_bytes. memory_layout.py formulas are unit-test cross-checks only (0.1% tolerance).
model_v3.memory_limit: Generated Lattigo code calls runtime/debug.SetMemoryLimit(limit) at the start of main, with limit taken from the CHEHAB_MEM_LIMIT_BYTES environment variable (the user's budget). Applied before phase instrumentation.
model_v3.memory_policy_lattigo_go: Go/GC allocator with an explicit per-run limit: GC keeps the managed heap near the live set. Allocator retention beyond the live set under the limit is UNMEASURED within v3 and intentionally not padded in.
model_v3.memory_policy_seal_cpp: UNMEASURED: no allocator-retention term has been measured for SEAL/C++ backends. Do not claim transferability of v3 to SEAL/C++ until such a term exists.

validation_v3.corpus_and_split: Same corpus, same development/holdout split as v2. The holdout was already seen by v2 (disclosed); no v3 coefficient is selected on holdout.
validation_v3.programs: CHEHAB-compiled programs only; no synthetic workloads.
validation_v3.budget_runs: Each measured program runs 3 repeats unconstrained (GOGC=100) and 3 repeats per budget with CHEHAB_MEM_LIMIT_BYTES set to the budget. /usr/bin/time records peak RSS and wall time.
reported_metrics: fraction of budget runs with peak RSS <= budget * 1.03, overall and per budget
overshoot percent: max over runs predicted as fits (v3 estimate <= budget) of (peak RSS / budget - 1) * 100
wall-time ratio vs unconstrained (median per program, distribution over programs)
count of runs where v3 says fits but peak RSS > budget (false accepts)
live-set estimate vs measured peak RSS under the memory policy
validation_v3.failure_honesty: Generation, build, and run failures are recorded in the failures CSV and excluded from denominators. Failures are reported as failures, never as zero.

gates_v3.slowdown: reported, not hidden; no gate threshold
gates_v3.coverage: not a v3 gate: v3 has no hi interval
